# Voice and tone

Friendly, direct and short. Plain words, active voice, no jargon.

Small product teams (2 to 20 people) who want a fast, simple website and a newsletter without hiring an agency.

transcript.args: {"query":"how to structure a product website launch announcement blog post"}
transcript.result: 5 results. Common pattern across launch posts: open with the problem, show 2-3 concrete improvements with numbers, add one customer quote, end with a single call to action. Typical length 600-900 words.

transcript.text: Plan for the post: open with the problem (slow sites and clunky editors), then the three headline features (pages load twice as fast, a simpler editor, a built-in newsletter form), a short quote from a beta customer, and one call to action: try the new site. Target length about 800 words, in the friendly, direct voice the guide asks for.

messages.body: Can you put together a checklist for launch day? The new site goes live on Thursday morning.

Here is a launch-day checklist, in order:

1. Confirm the new domain points to the site and HTTPS works
2. Check the redirects from the old URLs
3. Publish the launch blog post
4. Test the newsletter signup form end to end
5. Send the announcement email to subscribers
6. Post the launch thread on social
7. Watch signups and errors for the first two hours

Should I add owners and times?
Yes, add owners. And test the signup form before the post goes out.

Updated, with the signup test moved before the post:

1. 08:00 Domain and HTTPS check (Product team)
2. 08:15 Redirect check (SEO Auditor)
3. 08:30 Newsletter signup test (Growth team)
4. 09:00 Publish the launch blog post (Content Marketer)
5. 09:15 Announcement email (Content Marketer)
6. 09:30 Launch thread on social (Social Scheduler)
7. 09:30 to 11:30 Watch signups and errors (Growth team)
